description:
Meet Pip, a cheerful little owl who guides your little one around a sunny island full of learning games! Toddler Games: 2-5 Year Olds turns early learning into play with more than 900 levels across 8 colorful islands.

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
• No reading needed: glowing hands and big pictures show what to do
• Gentle feedback, no timers and no "game over"
• Difficulty adapts to age 2, 3, 4 or 5 (set by parents)
• Optional friendly voice in clear American English
• Plays offline after the first launch

8 ISLANDS, 900+ LEVELS
• Color Garden: sort colors, fit shapes, order sizes, complete patterns, pop balloons
• Puzzle Forest: jigsaw puzzles from 4 to 16 pieces, shadow matching, memory cards
• Number Hill: count 1 to 20, match numbers, first adding and taking away, trace numbers
• ABC Bay: trace uppercase and lowercase letters, letter sounds, find words that start with each letter
• Animal Farm: farm, wild and sea animals, animal sounds, who eats what
• Discovery Town: vehicles, jobs and their tools, seasons, weather and feelings
• Playground: mazes, connect the dots, odd one out
• Music Island: play xylophone, piano, bells and drums; learn simple tunes and memory rhythms

ALL IN ENGLISH
Every word, number, letter and voice prompt is in English, a gentle first step for young English learners too.

REWARDS
• 1 to 3 stars on every level
• A sticker album with 144 stickers, plus silver and gold versions
• A daily surprise gift

FOR PARENTS
• Parent area behind a parental gate: choose the age and see a progress report for every skill
• Purchases and settings are behind the parental gate
• No personal data collected

Five islands are completely free, and the first levels of ABC Bay, Number Hill and Music Island are free too. The ABC, Numbers and Music packs are optional one-time purchases, "Unlock Everything" opens all content, and Premium (monthly subscription) unlocks every level and pack while subscribed.

Subscription: Premium renews automatically every month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Microsoft account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel at account.microsoft.com/services.

Privacy Policy: https://mucobulut.github.io/oyunlar-destek/toddlergames/privacy/
short: 900+ learning games: trace ABC, count to 20, solve puzzles and make music with Pip the owl!
